classificationAudit.hardestAttack: D-056's second gate names successor authoring, while D-294 Decision 2(b) is triggered by semantic projected-value drift rather than version drift alone; therefore the maintenance successor might itself be remaining acceptance evidence.

setMembershipHolding.reason: Gate 2 first identifies the row's remaining acceptance-evidence members and then forbids splitting the listed authoring kinds when they are that remainder. It does not state that every independently owed successor on any maintenance or honesty duty automatically becomes a member of a row's acceptance-evidence set.
setMembershipHolding.adoptedPrecedent: D-085's adopted turn-3 subject holds A-CPC2-01 and A-CPC2-02 owed as honesty work on the first successor of the accepted DR-102 contract while expressly classifying them as not acceptance-evidence members and not SATISFIED-bars. That does not decide D-364 by itself, but it refutes the categorical reading that all outstanding successor work is necessarily inside gate 2.
setMembershipHolding.d294Role: Decision 2(b) creates the successor duty when a named projected value changes; Decision 3 requires a successor issued for any reason to refresh cross-lineage citations and leave frozen artifacts unedited. Neither decision classifies that duty as DR-117 acceptance evidence or as a SATISFIED bar.
setMembershipHolding.currentConcreteEffect: The two fired changes close the g29 and g30 fixture-authoring leftovers. They do not add missing design, a fixture, a schema, an undecided number, or a new acceptance reservation to DR-117. DR-117's live remainder remains execution of the fourteen named classes.
setMembershipHolding.laterCycleProtection: Clause 6 requires the later gates-4/5 entry to measure the row's remainder against live bytes at its own dispatch, not to use v10's frozen currency sentences as standing evidence. Any underlying future missing design or other gate-2 bar remains visible to that live measurement even though the separate citation-refresh duty is not itself a member.
setMembershipHolding.additionalContentBoundary: The adopted reading reaches the expressly described no-design, no-fixture, no-schema, no-number, no-binding-content citation-refresh class. If a later artifact combines that maintenance limb with independent design, schema, fixture, number, or binding content, the additional content does not acquire immunity merely because the artifact also performs a D-294 refresh; it must be classified on its own role under D-056.

d294Decision3NonExclusivityAttack.whyNoFinding: The draft does not need Decision 3 to forbid every possible extra edit. Clause 3 and the heading classify the minimal Decision 2(b) citation-refresh successor by the affirmative facts that it adds no design choice or other acceptance member and edits no frozen contract. Clause 9 carries that named class prospectively, not every multi-purpose artifact that happens also to refresh citations. Clause 6's fresh live measurement preserves the underlying gate-2 test.
